name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.193: The audio alignment has its own status light now - in the Workers list and
    directly under the download switch, with the same words and colours as every other worker.
    The switch says what it does at last: "Automatically synchronize subtitle to spoken track".
    The statistics count only alignments that really happened, so a subtitle that was already
    fine is no longer reported as one that the run moved. The postprocessing row is named for
    its direction: "Upl. Postproc.".
